n = int(input())
line = input()

brace_word_count = 0
max_word_len = 0

inside_parentheses = False
buffer = []

def update_counts(buf, in_braces):
    global brace_word_count, max_word_len
    length = len(buf)
    if length > 0:
        if in_braces:
            brace_word_count += 1
        else:
            max_word_len = max(max_word_len, length)

for i in range(n):
    c = line[i]
    if c == '_':
        update_counts(buffer, inside_parentheses)
        buffer = []
    elif c == '(':
        update_counts(buffer, inside_parentheses)
        buffer = []
        inside_parentheses = True
    elif c == ')':
        update_counts(buffer, inside_parentheses)
        buffer = []
        inside_parentheses = False
    elif c.isalpha():
        buffer.append(c)

update_counts(buffer, inside_parentheses)

print(f"{max_word_len} {brace_word_count}")
